design.title: Deeper borrowed eyes: each member's place description also reads two further ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV3-Small blocks (96 channels, 4x4), alongside the 48-channel 8x8 level it reads today
design.init_strategy: pretrained:mobilenet_v3_small IMAGENET1K_V1 features[0..10] (torchvision, BSD-3; model/pretrained/mnv3s_features10.pt, fine-tuned at 0.1x LR) + from-scratch two-level 1x1 lifts, cosine head, offset head
design.eli5: Last time we gave the model a pair of eyes that had already looked at a million ordinary photographs, and it suddenly started recognising Berlin in a photo it had never seen. But we only used the first, simplest part of those eyes — the part that notices edges and textures, which change a lot between summer and winter or bright and dull light. This experiment also plugs in the next, deeper part, which notices how things are arranged (this road meets that row of roofs next to that park), and that changes much less from one photograph to the next. The model keeps the detail it already had and gains the bigger picture.
design.hypothesis: Experiment 12 is the only design on this ruler that moved the held-out photograph out of the 6-14% usable band: swapping the from-scratch trunk for nine ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV3-Small blocks took truedop_2024 from 10.75% to 49.5% usable (false fix 7.0% -> 5.5%), with every other stage held fixed. That is a direct measurement that what transfers to a never-seen survey is the pretrained trunk's photometric/semantic invariance, and the remaining loss is now almost all abstention (45%), not false fixes (5.5%): when it answers it is right 90% of the time; it just does not recognise the place often enough. The training photographs sit at 96-98% usable at the same held-out viewpoints, so the gap is still the survey, not the viewpoint. Experiment 12 cut the pretrained network at its shallowest useful point (features[0..8], 48 channels at stride 16) -- the levels that encode edges and local texture, i.e. exactly the levels whose responses still change with exposure, season and shadow. In ImageNet-trained CNNs, invariance to colour, contrast and texture detail grows with depth; the next two blocks (features 9-10, 96 channels at stride 32, 128 m frame -> 4x4) respond to arrangements of parts (road junction + roof row + tree line) rather than their pixel texture. Giving the place descriptor access to that level, while keeping the current 8x8 level so nothing experiment 12 relied on is removed, should let more 2024 frames land on the same prototype direction as their training-survey twins, converting abstentions into usable fixes. This is distinct from experiment 5 (from-scratch extra stride-2 stages, which wrecked training fit because new layers had to learn whole-frame layout from three photographs): here the deeper blocks arrive pretrained on a million photographs and are only fine-tuned at 0.1x LR. Earlier-era exp 26/27/28 also used features[0..10], but under a region-holdout eval and six synthetic lighting buckets; their verdicts do not transfer. The weights are already baked: model/pretrained/mnv3s_features10.pt (verified at design time: loads strict into mobilenet_v3_small().features[:11], output 96x4x4 at 128 px, 576,464 params, and its blocks 0-8 are tensor-identical to mnv3s_features8.pt).
